subject: Jordan Rivera — interview day logistics & accessibility
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Rivera <jordan.rivera@example.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & logistics: Jordan Rivera — onsite day (Thu 6/24)

Hi all — looping folks in to finalize the candidate day for Jordan (PM). Jordan is confirmed for Thursday, June 24. Below is the proposed rhythm; please flag concerns or constraints.

Agenda (Pacific Time):
- 09:30 — Arrival / quick front-desk check-in (Jordan)
- 10:00 — Intro + hiring manager (Karthik) — 30m
- 10:40 — System design panel — 45m
- 11:35 — Lunch (candidate provided lunch voucher) — 45m
- 12:30 — Product case + cross-functional interview — 60m
- 13:45 — Wrap + recruiter close (Lauren) — 15m

Accessibility & ops asks from candidate thread: Jordan requested live captioning (real-time captions) and an ASL interpreter for the product case. Jordan also prefers brief breaks between longer interviews and would like a quiet/sensory-friendly room for a 10–15 minute reset after the system design panel.

Soojin — can you reserve the Quiet Suite (Q-3) for 12:15–12:35 and book on-site captioning + interpreter? If vendor needs an invoice/cost center, charge to Recruiting (CC: 401-RD). If there's a tech check window, earliest we can do is 9:15 on day-of.

Karthik — can you share any specific prep notes you want on the agenda item or if you prefer to run the product case remotely via whiteboard? Jordan noted that surprise live-coding is anxiety-inducing; please avoid ad-hoc live coding.

Jordan — attaching the day agenda and the resume we have on file. If you need any additional accommodations or prefer a remote-only loop for any interviewer, tell us and we will adjust.

Attachments:
- 20270603-jordan-agenda.pdf (agenda, interviewers, time blocks)
- candidate_resume_jrivera.pdf (resume supplied by candidate)

Thanks — we want the day to be predictable and low-friction.

Thanks,
Lauren

Subject: Re: Intro & logistics: Jordan Rivera — onsite day (Thu 6/24)

Hi Lauren / team — thanks for the clear plan and for checking on accommodations. A few quick notes: 
- Live captions + ASL interpreter: yes please. I use captions primarily and the interpreter for the product case where nuance matters.
- Breaks: 5–10 minute pauses between long sessions are perfect.
- Pronouns: he/they — no need to announce unless helpful to the panel.
- Arrival: I9ll aim for 9:30 and can do the 9:15 tech check if the vendor requests it.

Small preference: if the product case can avoid surprise whiteboarding or require pre-shared prompts, that would ease nerves. Happy to review any prompt in advance if helpful.

Looking forward — Jordan

- Tech check: 9:15 (Quiet Suite tech will test mic/captions with ClearVoice and the ASL interpreter). If you9re able to join for ~5 minutes that would be ideal; otherwise we9ll proceed and keep you copied.
- Zoom fallback: if any interviewer needs to drop remote, we will use this link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123 (passcode: Redwood.2027)
